subject: Impact confirmation request — BrightCart checkout availability & postmortem timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Lambert <sarah.lambert@brightcart.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@brightcart.com
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: [BrightCart] Checkout spike — confirmation of impact window and SLA credits

Hi Jordan / Lauren,

We observed a pronounced spike in checkout failures and 503s starting ~14:58 PST and lasting until ~15:10 PST today. The checkout success rate dropped from ~99.6% to 78% and a subset of payments retried multiple times. This affected about 3.2% of transactions during the window and caused a visible uptick in abandoned carts on our side.

Can you confirm Redwood's observed impact window and whether this falls under the availability SLA for BrightCart? Our procurement team will need:
- confirmation of the exact outage window (UTC)
- an initial assessment of whether this meets the threshold for a pro-rated credit
- any immediate mitigation steps you took

I've attached a small telemetry snippet and a sample merchant trace (brightcart-telemetry-snippet.json) showing the client side timing and first 503 occurrences.

If you confirm, we'll submit the SLO credit form and request a postmortem. We'd like an estimated timeline for a postmortem and the raw logs you can share for audit.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lambert
Head of Payments, BrightCart

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding BrightCart's report — they have provided a client-side snippet and are requesting: confirmed outage window, eligibility for SLO credit, and a postmortem timeline. TL;DR from our prelims:
- Error class: elevated 5xx (majority 503 with a small tail of 502) across a small subset of pods in us-west-2 region.
- Apparent trigger: brief control-plane rolling push coincident with a traffic surge; autoscaler lagged for ~70s per internal traces.

Please pull:
- server request logs for us-west-2 between 2028-11-03T22:58:00Z and 2028-11-03T23:12:00Z (UTC window corresponding to their local times)
- the autoscaler event timeline and any kernel trace around the rolling push
- delta of successful token-serving latency before/during/after the window

If this maps to our availability SLA (>=5m continuous downtime or equivalent weighted error budget hit), we should prepare a credit calculation and the raw log bundle (raw-503-sample-20281103.log). Please flag any reason this should be excluded (planned maintenance, customer-side misconfiguration, etc.).

I can own comms to BrightCart once we have the confirmed window and whether qualifies.

Thanks —
Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lambert <sarah.lambert@brightcart.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 5 Nov 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [BrightCart] Checkout spike — confirmation of impact window and SLA credits

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for your patience. We've completed the initial verification and can confirm the following:

- Observed impact window (UTC): 2028-11-03T22:58:13Z to 2028-11-03T23:10:45Z (12m 32s).
- Root cause (preliminary): an automated rolling control-plane update coincided with a ~1.8x traffic surge for BrightCart's checkout route. During the update, a small subset of serving pods experienced a KV cache missstorm that increased tail latency and produced short-lived 503s while autoscaler lagged.
- Eligibility: Per BrightCart's SLA (99.9% monthly availability), this 12m+ window constitutes an availability event that meets the threshold for a pro-rated credit. We'll calculate the exact credit per the contract and share the figure in the next 24 hours.

What we're providing now (attachments and links):
- raw-503-sample-20281103.log (server-side request/response pairs for the window)
- brightcart-telemetry-snippet.json (the client-side snippet you attached, annotated)
- slo-credit-form.pdf (pre-filled with the confirmed window for your review)
- Drive folder with full log bundle: https://drive.redwood.ai/brightcart/incident-20281103

Next steps / timeline:
- Within 24 hours: formal credit calculation and payout options (pro-rata for the monthly invoice or applied as account credit).
- Within 72 hours: consolidated postmortem draft with technical details, mitigation steps, and changes to prevent recurrence (we'll include timeline of the control-plane update and autoscaler tuning actions).

If you need anything sooner (for procurement or audit), let me know and we can expedite the credit paperwork. Apologies again for the impact — we take SLA events seriously and will follow up with concrete remediation steps.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
